name: Cel-shaded cartoon with heavy outline
why: Flat fills plus a dark contour are the most reproducible style for generative art: the contour is a hard boundary a validator can measure, it hides the seam where skeletal parts overlap, and limited tonal steps keep separately generated assets in the same visual family.

prompt_skeleton.style_medium: 2D game asset, cel-shaded cartoon illustration, bold dark outline, flat colour fills with {tones} tonal steps, no texture noise, no photographic detail
prompt_skeleton.lighting_mood: single light source from {light_direction}, soft ambient fill, no cast shadow on the asset itself
constraints: asset fills the canvas with a {margin_pct}% margin
no ground plane, no scenery, no text, no watermark
avoid: gradients spanning more than two stops
drop shadows baked into the sprite
cropped or touching the canvas edge

unit_design_rules: Joints are hidden by overlap — a pauldron covers the shoulder, a skirt covers the hip. This is what makes skeletal cut-up invisible in a style with a contour.
Parts are generated as parts under one declared light direction, never cut out of a finished whole.
Cloth, smoke, flags and auras are procedural (shader or particles), not skeletal parts.
